draft.emotion: contented and settled, looking at things that belong together
notes: Inflects to जोड़े (joṛe) in the plural and before postpositions.
Often interchangeable with the feminine noun जोड़ी (joṛī), though जोड़ा is also used for a complete set of clothes (such as a suit or wedding outfit).
